set -u BARGE=/usr/local/bin/barge RUN_ROOT=${TMPDIR:-/var/tmp} WORK=$(/usr/bin/mktemp -d "$RUN_ROOT/barge-maintain.XXXXXX") || { echo "barge maintain: no temporary directory under $RUN_ROOT; nothing was run" exit 2 } cleanup() { if [ -n "$WORK" ] && [ -d "$WORK" ]; then /bin/rm -f "$WORK/preview.json" "$WORK/real.json" "$WORK/plan.json" /bin/rmdir "$WORK" 2>/dev/null fi } trap cleanup EXIT
# 1. Preview. Effect-free. An exit of 3 *with a plan document* is a completed run # that needs a human (an absent permanent volume, a pending intent), not a # refusal, so it must not stop the work the same run authorized. "$BARGE" maintain --json --plan-out "$WORK/plan.json" >"$WORK/preview.json" preview_exit=$?
read_key() { /usr/bin/python3 - "$WORK/preview.json" "$1" <<'PY' import json, sys try: with open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8") as handle: document = json.load(handle) except Exception: raise SystemExit(1) if document.get("schema") != "barge.maintain/1" or document.get("ok") is not True: raise SystemExit(1) print(document["data"][sys.argv[2]]) PY }
# A document that is not a maintain plan means the command refused or could not # report: record its exit and stop. Nothing was planned. if ! DIGEST=$(read_key plan_digest) || ! CANDIDATES=$(read_key candidates); then echo "barge maintain: preview exit=$preview_exit and no plan document; recorded, not retried" exit "$preview_exit" fi
if [ "$CANDIDATES" -eq 0 ]; then echo "barge maintain: preview exit=$preview_exit candidates=0; nothing to do, recorded, not retried" exit "$preview_exit" fi
# 2. Exactly one real run, with this preview's digest and its exact bytes. No # retry, and never a digest from an earlier preview. "$BARGE" maintain --json --plan "$WORK/plan.json" --plan-sha256 "$DIGEST" >"$WORK/real.json" real_exit=$?
# 3. Record both exit codes and exit with the worse one, so a loud absence (3) is # never lost and a later success never hides an earlier refusal. status=$real_exit if [ "$preview_exit" -gt "$status" ]; then status=$preview_exit fi echo "barge maintain: preview exit=$preview_exit real exit=$real_exit digest=$DIGEST candidates=$CANDIDATES status=$status; recorded, not retried" exit "$status"
